items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: I had written James Reese Europe because a lot of boys out of the Jenkins office was in his band, just a whole lot.

ctx.x: Yeah, and when they asked for the card, there were about five of us in there who were supposed to be fellows of war age. And I didn't have my card in my pocket. The fact of it is I had gone to the circus that day in my shirt sleeve because we put on our band coats in the tent, under the tent. And well, where's your card? And they got right hostile with me, you know. They grabbed me. I said, it's down the privilege card. No, you won't go get anything, they said. We're going to take you on in. You were instructed…
I can't picture it. It's in Kansas, though.
